errors.what: Started the site build with a trailing '&' inside a run_in_background command, so the harness reported it finished at once while build.mjs kept running detached
errors.fix: Checked ps; the build finished on its own. Used research/_homepage/build.py directly (2.5 s) for before/after, which was all this change needed

doc_friction.issue: 'Pick one piece of work' asks for a full build.mjs + screenshots of five surfaces first (3 to 20 min). For a research-page fix, research/_homepage/build.py builds in 2.5 s and old-vs-new could be compared by stashing; a line saying so would save time

Has to be run from platform/ci (python3 -m unittest test_research_homepage_publish); 'python3 -m unittest platform/ci/...' from the repo root fails because 'platform' shadows the stdlib module, and the bare python3 has no pytest

deviations.why: Did not screenshot the hub, a flagship, the Stories page and a blog post before choosing; the last polish report named a concrete research-page defect, and grepping the built dist turned up a much larger version of it (1,075 hits)
deviations.did: Measured the defect class across all research output instead, and took element screenshots of before and after
deviations.result: Found and fixed 1,075 escaped entities on 91 files plus ~125 false italic runs, with a regression test

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
